column1: Field data acquisition: High-speed mobile laser scanning of designated urban areas using the MMS L-Scan Premium D2 to capture high-density 3D point clouds and panoramic imagery of building facades.
column2: Raw and Processed Point Clouds: Calibrated and classified 3D point clouds of the surveyed urban areas in industry-standard formats (.LAS / .LAZ).
column3: Data Accuracy (Absolute): Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of the processed 3D point cloud remains within ≤ 5 cm for all surveyed urban routes under stable GNSS coverage.
column4: Technical & Regulatory Clarifications for the Mobile Mapping Project in Vietnam. See details in Discussion page.

column1: Data processing: Georeferencing, point cloud calibration, strip adjustment, and filtering of the collected urban geospatial data.
column2: 3D Building Models: 3D models of surveyed buildings integrated into a georeferenced map database.
column3: Data Completeness: 100% coverage of the agreed urban roads and target building facades without critical data gaps or scanning shadow zones.
column4: Provide SUV/Pickup with a driver, compatible rails and access to a secure garage.

column1: 3D Modeling & Integration: Generation of 3D building models based on the processed point clouds and integration of these objects into the digital map framework.
column3: GIS System Compatibility: Successful and seamless integration of the generated 3D building models into the customer’s existing digital mapping or GIS platform.

column2: Final Project Report: Technical documentation detailing the survey methodology, data quality control (QA/QC) analysis, and accuracy assessment reports.
